messages.author: 697cdfacf5b0f418
messages.subject: Error in nb2INLA("mapus.adj", us_shp.poly) : Cannot open file
parts:
Hello INLA expert,

I could not use nb2INLA to Convert the adjacency matrix into a file in the INLA format. I got the error:

Error in nb2INLA("mapus.adj", us_shp.poly) : Cannot open file
In addition: Warning message:
In file.create(file) :
  cannot create file 'mapus.adj', reason 'Permission denied'

Can anyone please help me?

Many thanks!
Bill

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error in nb2INLA("mapus.adj", us_shp.poly) : Cannot open file
parts:
try to save the file in a place you have write access, like

nb2INLA("/tmp/mapus,adj", us_shp.poly)

f.exe
